card.title: Private Access
card.instruction: Use shared confidences and private knowledge as quiet leverage, never stating how much influence that closeness gives you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before your guests arrive, could we settle which version of last summer I'm remembering?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The one where you watered my plants.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll leave your envelope in my drawer, then. Could we talk upstairs?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm supposed to be welcoming people.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll welcome them while you find us a quiet room. Plants are such a safe subject.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 asks which shared story may be told, A3 links discretion about an envelope to a private conversation, and A5 uses safe guest talk to press for a room.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's plants version informs A3's agreement to leave the envelope private; B4's hosting duty becomes A5's offer to host while B finds privacy.

relationship.evidence: B2 identifies the safe public account and B4 has a real obligation to welcome arriving guests.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's hosting obstacle to take over guest conversation, quietly preserving leverage through the chosen plants topic.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes arriving guests and competing versions of last summer; A3 states the immediate request to talk upstairs.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's safe-subject line echoes B2's plants story after offering to speak to the guests.
